answer: Co-attestation graph audit. Every peer vote is written as an edge, so the network sees who vouches for whom. Each epoch an auditor scores young accounts by voter overlap: when 60% of an identity's attestors also backed three accounts born in the same 48 hours, the cluster is flagged and each seat forfeits its 200 POA bond. A farm of 5,000 clones then needs 5,000 unrelated established accounts vouching separately, costing 200,000 POA and months of genuine history. A real account grows rings like a willow; a clone farm reprints one sonnet, lights no ember.
